ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels is approximately 1:5 across the visible ventral surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white mottling located on the mid-to-inner region of the right lobe; several isolated linear white streaks on the central left lobe; focal high-intensity clusters concentrated near the fluke tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an internal vertex angle of approximately 42 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 15% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge exhibits continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude (2-8 pixel) serrations; distal tips show extreme jaggedness with irregular protrusions exceeding 20 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge boundary follows an irregularly concave trajectory from the median notch to the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clustered circular high-intensity pixel groups visible on the central-lower portion of the right lobe and scattered near the distal margin of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, unaligned high-intensity linear marks visible on the left lobe; two smaller horizontal linear disruptions near the central peduncle junction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive textured dark protrusions (barnacle colonization) present on the distal tips and sections of the trailing edge; significant white scarring on the inner right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Severe distal tip boundary irregularity characterized by dense textural clusters and non-linear pixel transitions, distinct from the primary trailing edge topography.
